decisions: C start = B-return start + Mirror and Shears injected (r9 required legal acquisition and forbade injection)
C success = wig claimed by any route + offering + chapter0.complete; no knockout; leaving the enclosure allowed (r9: Griffin HP 0 + wig, enclosure boundary, no return)

Existing B pin tests verify the 2791bce run path from git history (owner approved)
Owner approval 2026-11-06: C2 = baseline-griffin-heuristic-v1; baseline-inventory-heuristic-v1 excluded as C-specific exploratory
Owner approval 2026-11-06: scenario, injected start and success rule (wig + offering + chapter0.complete; peaceful valid)
Owner revision 2026-11-06: neutral briefing text (no 'prepared', tools, nest, grooming or peaceful solution), identical for C1/C3
Owner request 2026-11-06: descriptive route metrics in summaries (situationCReport), not success requirements
consequences: C and B-return now share start state (except the two items), limits, knockout rule and end point (chapter0.complete); they differ in the items, the Griffin-defeat requirement (B only) and the prompt framing (B-return: task line, no tutorial/briefing; C: tutorial + briefing). B vs C is therefore not an inventory-only contrast.
With the tools, the peaceful route is a legal shortcut in C, so C is expected to be easier than B; it tests whether players use the prepared items.
Maze and pond chests remain unclaimed and their banter flags unset in C's world (the items were injected); a player who detours there could collect duplicates. No player needs to.
C1 (pre-tuned) is not byte-identical to any earlier pre-tuned prompt: it uses Pilot-31's tutorial but the owner's new C briefing.

The briefing ends at the offering; success also needs chapter0.complete, reached through the game's dialogue scenes after the offering. The generic task line ('Complete the Goddess's quest together.') still applies.
C1/C3 asymmetry (review round 2, finding 7): only C3's v4 step 8 ('follow the task to its end') reinforces continuing past the offering to chapter0.complete; part of the guidance effect.
amendmentR10.disclosure: Decided before any C model outcome. The unchanged baseline's C outcome is known from free preparation runs (3/3 success); no model policy was changed after it.
